simple.meaning: עֲמָשַׂי (ʻĂmâsay) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, beginning at 1 Chronicles 6:10. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲמָשַׂי (H6022) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֲמָשַׂי through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: Amasai , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H6022. Amasay עֲמָשַׂי proper name, masculine (compare foregoing); — 1 warrior of David 1Chr 12:19 (van d. H. v. 12:18 ), Αμασαι , perhaps = אֲבִישִׁי ( 2Sam 23:18 ). 2 Levites: a. 1Chr 6:10 ; 6:20 ( עֲמָשָׂ֑י ). b. 2Chr 29:12 . c. priest 1Chr 15:24 .
